info.title: Personal AI Workspace API
info.description: Authenticated REST endpoints for account identity, Home and project-scoped conversations, project tasks, owner-wide task queries, durable project facts, and AI runs.

post.summary: Prepare or replay a bounded workspace JSON export

200.description: Exact idempotent request replayed while its artifact remains ready.

404.description: Workspace is foreign, inactive, or being removed.

409.description: Matching request is still building or the idempotency key cannot be replayed.

413.description: The workspace exceeds a file, structured-data, total-document, or deadline bound; no partial export is published.

429.description: At most two unexpired exports may be active per owner.

422.description: Recognized credential-like content makes the structured export unsafe; no artifact is published.

get.summary: Download one ready owner-owned workspace export

200.description: Private JSON bytes. Cache-Control is no-store and nosniff is enabled.

404.description: Artifact is missing, expired, foreign, removed, or unavailable.

get.summary: List the current owner's schedules

200.description: Owner-scoped schedules without prompt or context contents.

post.summary: Create a workspace-scoped daily schedule

201.description: Created, or replayed the same idempotent schedule.

404.description: The workspace or skill is unavailable.

409.description: The idempotency key was reused with different input.

patch.summary: Revise or pause an existing schedule

200.description: Updated schedule revision.

404.description: The schedule or its workspace is unavailable.

409.description: The schedule revision is stale or has unresolved work.

post.summary: Queue or replay an immediate schedule occurrence

200.description: Idempotent replay of the same occurrence.

404.description: The schedule or its workspace is unavailable.

409.description: A conflicting schedule revision or unresolved occurrence exists.

get.summary: List bounded schedule run history

200.description: A bounded page of metadata; narrative remains in the bound Home conversation.

404.description: The schedule is unavailable.

post.summary: Sign in to a regular account

200.description: Authenticated principal and CSRF value; session token is set in a secure HttpOnly cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque host-only session cookie with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, and Path=/.

403.description: The request Origin is not allowed.

get.summary: Read the current authenticated principal

200.description: Current principal and CSRF value.

post.summary: Create or resume a private demo identity
post.description: Requires the exact configured Origin. A valid session cookie also requires X-CSRF-Token; a valid demo session resumes without a new cookie, and a regular session is preserved with a 409 response. Anonymous callers require a high-entropy Idempotency-Key. A cookie-less replay returns only pending/ready status and never receives a session credential.

200.description: A valid demo session resumed without extending its expiry, or a cookie-less idempotency replay reports ready status.

201.description: A new demo identity, empty-account storage state, and opaque session were provisioned.

Set-Cookie.description: The existing host-only session cookie, expiring with the demo account.

202.description: A cookie-less idempotency replay reports that admission is still pending; no cookie is set.

409.description: A valid regular-account session is active; its cookie and session remain unchanged.

429.description: Persistent global, network, or per-demo run-start admission limits were reached.

503.description: Required admission settings/storage are unavailable or bounded provisioning failed.

get.summary: Check whether a new private demo can be admitted
get.description: Returns only a safe availability bit. A false result covers unpublished or unavailable bounded prerequisites; no operator content or storage details are disclosed.

200.description: Availability result.

get.summary: Read the current immutable public showcase
get.description: Returns only the currently published sanitized snapshot. It is a separate read-only resource and never exposes an administrator source project or provider context.

200.description: Current public snapshot.

404.description: No showcase is currently published.

get.summary: Download a file from the current immutable showcase
get.description: Only file IDs in the current snapshot resolve. Responses are attachment downloads with nosniff and a server-owned closed MIME type; HTML and SVG are not served inline.

200.description: Current file bytes; the response is always an attachment.

404.description: The file is not part of the current showcase.

get.summary: Read the authenticated account owner’s usage and AI admission status
get.description: The owner is derived from the authenticated session. Returns the caller’s own credit and storage totals only; it does not claim provider readiness.

200.description: Owner-scoped usage snapshot.

503.description: Accounting or storage usage is unavailable; clients must fail closed for AI submission.

get.summary: Search bounded account usage summaries
get.description: Requires an active regular administrator. Returns at most 100 accounts and aggregate limits/usage; no resource content or credentials are exposed.

200.description: Bounded account summaries.

403.description: An active regular administrator is required.

post.summary: Create a regular user account
post.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token. Role is always user; the initial password is hashed and never returned.

201.description: Created regular account; credentials are not returned.

403.description: Origin/CSRF validation failed or an active regular administrator is required.

409.description: The account identifier is already in use.

patch.summary: Replace account credit and logical storage limits
patch.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token. Updates use expectedRevision CAS. A null limit is unlimited; string zero means no credit spending or storage growth. Existing usage and reservations are preserved even when a new limit is lower.

200.description: Updated limits revision.

404.description: The target account does not exist.

409.description: The expected limits revision is stale.

patch.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token. Disabling revokes the target’s sessions. The last active administrator cannot be disabled.

200.description: Updated account status.

404.description: The target account does not exist.

409.description: Disabling the last active administrator is not allowed.

post.summary: Reset an account password
post.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token. Accepts a new password only, hashes it, and revokes all target sessions. No password value is returned or audited.

200.description: Password reset and all sessions revoked.

404.description: The target account does not exist.

post.summary: Revoke an account’s active sessions
post.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token.

200.description: Sessions revoked.

404.description: The target account does not exist.

get.summary: Read persisted demo policy settings and shared usage
get.description: Requires an active regular administrator. The emergency inference pause applies to all accounts. Shared daily and campaign settled/reserved totals are returned without exposing individual demo usage.

200.description: Persisted settings and shared usage.

403.description: An active regular administrator is required.

put.description: Requires an active regular administrator, exact Origin, and CSRF token. expectedRevision provides CAS. Null limits are unlimited; string zero is a zero cap. Campaign identity may be initialized from null once; ordinary edits must retain an existing ID or receive DEMO_CAMPAIGN_ID_IMMUTABLE. Editing the cap for the same campaign preserves its settled and reserved counters and usage ledger. inferencePaused is the emergency pause for all accounts.

200.description: Updated persisted policy and current shared usage.

409.description: ADMIN_REVISION_CONFLICT for a stale expectedRevision, or DEMO_CAMPAIGN_ID_IMMUTABLE for changing or clearing an already configured campaign ID.

get.summary: Read recent safe administrator audit metadata
get.description: Requires an active regular administrator. Results are bounded and contain no credentials, secrets, or resource content.

200.description: Recent safe audit metadata.

403.description: An active regular administrator is required.

post.summary: Build an exact admin-only sanitized showcase preview
post.description: The administrator selects only active owned-project tasks, active facts, and regular files. File bytes are returned to this admin in a bounded preview so the reviewed bytes match what can be published.

200.description: Exact selected visitor projection and admin-only file bytes.

404.description: The owned active project or a selected source is unavailable.

413.description: The selected snapshot exceeds configured finite bounds.

503.description: Required bounded settings or trusted source storage are unavailable.

post.summary: Publish an unchanged admin-previewed showcase version
post.description: The server recomputes the exact preview digest and source revision before atomically inserting an immutable version and switching the current pointer. A same-key matching replay returns the original version; same-key different-input use conflicts. Existing demo admissions retain their original pinned version.

201.description: A new immutable version was published.

200.description: A matching idempotent replay returned the original published version.

404.description: The owned active project or a selected source is unavailable.

409.description: Preview became stale or the idempotency key was reused with different input.

413.description: The selected snapshot exceeds configured finite bounds.

503.description: Publication configuration or storage is unavailable; the pointer is unchanged.

get.summary: Read the current demo copy readiness state
get.description: Requires the current demo cookie. Returns no source/snapshot IDs, selected source data, paths, quota totals, or partial project content. The private projectId is null until the copy is fully ready; when ready it identifies only this authenticated owner's private project. Pending copies return 202.

200.description: Ready or failed copy state.

post.summary: Retry a known-safe copy setup operation
post.description: Requires the current demo cookie, exact Origin, and CSRF token. Reuses the same admission, pinned version, target IDs, and durable operation manifest. Unknown storage outcomes are not retryable until reconciliation.

200.description: Copy is ready or this request reports a terminal safe state.

409.description: Copy is terminal, unpinned, over its attempt limit, or has an unknown side effect.

get.summary: List the supported starter skill templates

200.description: Fixed starter templates with closed Home capability declarations.

get.summary: List the caller's active skills

200.description: Active caller-owned skills, optionally restricted to one workspace.

post.summary: Create a versioned skill or copy a fixed starter template
post.description: Owner identity comes only from the authenticated session. Instructions are stored as user data, and declared tools are restricted to the server's closed Home capability list.

201.description: New private skill; matching idempotent replays return the same skill.

404.description: The selected workspace is unavailable or this matching skill creation was later soft-deleted.

409.description: The idempotency key was reused with different input.

get.summary: Read one caller-owned active skill

200.description: Current immutable skill revision.

404.description: The skill is unavailable to this caller.

patch.summary: Edit or enable or disable a skill by expected version

200.description: Updated current skill revision.

404.description: The skill or selected workspace is unavailable.

409.description: The skill version is stale.

delete.summary: Soft delete a skill by expected version

204.description: The skill is no longer available for invocation.

404.description: The skill is unavailable to this caller.

409.description: The skill version is stale.

post.summary: Start an idempotent skill invocation in an existing Home conversation
post.description: The invocation snapshots the immutable skill revision and permitted context source IDs/revisions, then uses the existing Home turn, provider, policy, quota, and runtime path. A bound replay returns the current turn and never starts the runtime twice.

200.description: The existing Home turn is starting, running, terminal, or an identical idempotent replay.

404.description: The skill, conversation, or workspace is unavailable to this principal.

409.description: The skill version is stale or the Idempotency-Key was already used for different input.

get.summary: Read the authenticated Home or workspace policy and readiness
get.description: Returns a display-only policy snapshot. The snapshot is not authorization for a later dispatch. Home requires scope=home without projectId; workspace requires scope=workspace and the exact projectId. No owner, provider endpoint, or policy update input is accepted. This GET does not require Origin or CSRF headers.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Required exactly when scope=workspace; forbidden for scope=home.

200.description: Owner-scoped stored policy, safe included context and a separate fail-closed readiness state.

404.description: The requested workspace is not visible to this principal.

get.summary: Read storage accounting for the authenticated account
get.description: Returns exact logical byte totals for the signed-in principal only. During reconciliation or when accounting is unavailable, the route still returns 200 with the configured limit and null unverified totals; it never reports an unverified zero.

200.description: Owner-scoped storage usage. Examples cover ready, unlimited, zero-limit, over-limit, and unverified accounting states.

HomeIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
HomeIdempotencyHeader.description: Stable identity for replaying a Home conversation or turn submission.

HomeProposalIfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
HomeProposalIfMatchHeader.description: Current positive proposal revision, with or without surrounding quotes.

WorkspaceDirectory.name: directory
WorkspaceDirectory.description: Normalized project-relative directory. Absolute and host paths are rejected.

WorkspaceQuery.name: query
WorkspaceQuery.description: Case-insensitive phrase or multi-term query. Matching lines rank by phrase, line-term coverage, then file-term coverage.

DemoAdmissionCsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
DemoAdmissionCsrfHeader.description: Required only when a valid session cookie is presented; anonymous admission relies on exact Origin validation.

DemoAdmissionIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
DemoAdmissionIdempotencyHeader.description: Required for anonymous admission; 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as canonical unpadded base64url. It is not a session credential and cookie-less retries never receive a cookie.

ShowcaseIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
ShowcaseIdempotencyHeader.description: Stable publish retry key scoped to the active administrator; matching replays return the original version and different-input reuse conflicts.

SkillIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
SkillIdempotencyHeader.description: Stable retry key scoped to the authenticated owner; different-input reuse conflicts.

SkillIfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
SkillIfMatchHeader.description: Current positive skill version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

WorkspaceIdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
WorkspaceIdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable key for replaying this workspace mutation. Reusing it for a different request returns a conflict.

ProjectIfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
ProjectIfMatchHeader.description: Current positive workspace version as a decimal integer, without quotes.

IfMatchVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchVersionHeader.description: Current positive fact version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

ProjectTaskFilter.name: status
ProjectTaskFilter.description: Task filter: all (default), open, or completed.

ProjectTaskSuggestionStatusFilter.name: status
ProjectTaskSuggestionStatusFilter.description: Use pending (default) for unresolved suggestions or all for pending and resolved suggestions. status=all requires conversationId.

ProjectTaskSuggestionConversationId.name: conversationId

StorageQuotaExceeded.description: Positive content growth would exceed the configured storage limit. Safe byte-count details are decimal strings; no path or content is returned.

error.message: The storage quota does not allow this increase.

StorageWriteTooLarge.description: Either a source payload cap was exceeded (FILE_TOO_LARGE) or positive content growth exceeds the storage limit (STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED). Quota byte-count details are decimal strings.

error.message: The file exceeds the configured size limit.
The storage quota does not allow this increase.

StorageWriteUnavailable.description: This status may also carry an existing route-specific workspace, runtime, or review error. An accounting-unready state may return 503 on affected writes, including state-only and delete routes. When accounting is ready, being over limit alone does not block a zero or negative byte delta such as a shrink or deletion. Reconciliation-pending errors disclose only an opaque operation ID, never a host path.

error.message: Storage accounting is not ready for this account.
The file operation outcome is pending reconciliation.

StorageFileConflict.description: A file/resource version conflict or filesystem operation conflict occurred. Storage errors use STORAGE_OPERATION_CONFLICT or STORAGE_FILE_STATE_CHANGED and disclose no host path.

error.message: The operation key was already used for a different file mutation.

limitUnits.description: Null means unlimited; the string "0" means no allowance.

canSubmit.description: Authoritative local admission state; does not assert a production provider is configured or ready.

campaignId.description: May initialize from null; once set, later edits must keep the same value. Clearing or rotating returns HTTP 409 DEMO_CAMPAIGN_ID_IMMUTABLE.

inferencePaused.description: Emergency inference pause applying to all accounts.

AdminDemoSettingsUpdateRequest.description: Null limits are unlimited; the string "0" is a zero limit. expectedRevision is a compare-and-swap token. campaignId and campaignLimitUnits must both be set or both be null. Editing the cap without changing campaignId preserves settled and reserved usage.

identifier.description: Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed and ASCII letters are lowercased before the normalized identifier is validated.

password.description: Must contain at least one non-whitespace character. The password is verified without trimming or normalization.

DemoAdmissionRequest.description: No caller-selected identity, expiry, path, or credit fields are accepted.

items.description: Normalized project-relative path; never a host path or storage root.

skillIds.description: Optional explicit allowlist of enabled account-wide or source-project skills; omitted means no skills.

ShowcaseSkill.description: Reviewed fields from an explicitly selected enabled skill; source IDs, owner scope, policy, provider, and runtime files are omitted.

PreviewFile.description: Admin-only exact selected bytes. Generated public IDs are allocated at publish and are intentionally absent from preview.

ShowcaseSkillDto.description: Public generated skill ID and reviewed fields; no source owner or runtime identity.

projectId.description: Owner-private target project ID. Null unless state is ready; never returned by public showcase endpoints.

name.description: A validated project-relative selection; never a host path.

AccountStorageUsage.description: Owner-scoped logical storage usage. When state is reconciling or unavailable, unverified totals and asOf are null while the configured limit remains visible.

usedBytes.description: Exact non-negative base-10 byte count, or null while unverified.

reservedBytes.description: Exact non-negative base-10 byte count, or null while unverified.

limitBytes.description: Null means unlimited; zero disallows positive growth.

availableBytes.description: Null means unlimited or unverified; otherwise max(limit minus used minus reserved, zero).

title.description: Trimmed non-whitespace title without control characters.

content.description: Non-whitespace plain text; line breaks are preserved.
Exact redacted fact value shown for provider disclosure and transmitted only after approval.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical redacted title, content, and user source label passed to provider context.

request.description: Trimmed request, capped at 8,000 UTF-8 bytes; credential-like assignments are rejected.

factIds.description: Explicitly selected active project facts; defaults to none. At most 25 distinct IDs are accepted after repeated IDs are deduplicated. Selected facts are included in the exact disclosure snapshot.

includeRecentMessages.description: Selects at most 20 latest redacted messages within the aggregate byte/token ceiling.

facts.description: Exact redacted project fact content that may be transmitted if the user approves; each item is tied to a version and source hash.

outputPreview.description: Optional server-redacted plain-text preview; never HTML or ANSI.

summary.description: Server-bounded plain-text command summary; it never contains raw paths or credentials.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of original bytes before normalization/redaction; required for stale-safe manual edits/deletes.

WorkspaceSearchMatch.description: Redacted single-line excerpt. Paths are relative to the selected project root.

WorkspaceSearch.description: Ranked deterministic matches. Search considers no more than 200 file candidates and 20,000 lines, subject to per-file, output-byte, depth, and operation-time limits. `filesScanned` counts candidates reached, including candidates later skipped by size or text checks. `truncated` indicates possible omissions; a timeout returns an error instead.

filesScanned.description: Number of bounded file candidates processed, including candidates skipped by size or text checks.

ProjectTaskSource.description: Server-owned immutable task provenance. User-authored tasks have null suggestion/run/conversation linkage and acceptedAt; accepted suggestions have server-recorded linkage and timestamp.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

position.description: Zero-based position in the task collection.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.
